title: Child Labor Law Investigations (Nevada Office Of The Labor Commissioner)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

-Final investigation reports concerning alleged violations of child labor law violations

-Final investigative findings, determinations, and case closure reports documenting the outcomes of completed child labor violation investigations.

-Final notices of violation, citations, administrative orders, penalty assessments, and enforcement actions issued in connection with completed child labor investigations.

-Existing correspondence notifying employers of investigative findings, violations, penalties, corrective actions, or case closures.

-Existing spreadsheets, reports, or case summaries identifying completed child labor investigations, including investigation dates, employer names, alleged violations, dispositions, and assessed penalties, where recorded.

This request is being made by a journalistic researcher. It is being made for research purposes, not commercial ones. Please assess fees in accordance with provisions for media requesters. In the event that this agency decides to charge this requester fees not to exceed the actual cost of reproducing the records, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request.

Please fulfill this request electronically, preferably by e-mail attachment, if available.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response within the statutorily-mandated timeframe.

Sincerely,

Lilly Hardy
